component.name: Mooring
component.summary: Your Android phone on the Linux desktop

description.p: Mooring brings your Android phone to the desktop in one window: read and send text messages, see and answer the phone's notifications, browse the newest photos, send files and the clipboard, and show the phone's screen or run a single phone app in its own window.
It is a front end: the phone connection is handled by KDE Connect, and mirroring by scrcpy and adb.
First release: messages, notifications, photos, files, clipboard, screen mirroring and phone apps.
